summary.name: GitMind
summary.one_liner: GitMind is an AI-powered mind mapping, flowchart, and whiteboard app that turns text, videos, audio, PDFs, websites, and images into summaries and structured mind maps.
use_cases: Summarizing lecture videos, podcasts, or audio into notes
Turning PDFs, articles, or books into mind maps for study
Generating flowcharts or UML diagrams from descriptions
Converting photos of handouts into editable text
summary.what_it_does: The page describes GitMind as an all-in-one AI workspace that converts text, videos, audio, PDFs, websites, and images into summaries, structured mind maps, and visual insights. It lists tools for extracting text from YouTube videos and audio, summarizing PDFs and books, and extracting text from images. It also mentions generating flowcharts, UML diagrams, org charts, and infographics, plus a prompt-to-mind-map feature. Collaboration and real-time sharing of mind maps are mentioned in the description and testimonials. The page states that user data is not used for model training or advertising and that users can delete it.
notable: AI conversion of videos, audio, PDFs, and images into summaries and mind maps
Prompt to mind map and AI flowchart/UML/infographic generators
States user data is not used for model training or advertising and can be deleted
caveats: Page does not state specific pricing tiers or limits; described as free in the meta description only
Platform availability beyond the web app is not confirmed on the page
Most content is marketing and user testimonials; no independent feature details are given
